label: Neurology
description: Neurological and neurogenetic conditions, including epilepsy syndromes, demyelinating disease, and brain tumors, with a focus on genetic variants and imaging/EEG findings.

fewShotExamples.input: 8-year-old girl with Dravet syndrome, SCN1A mutation positive, drug-resistant epilepsy since infancy...
35-year-old woman with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis, new T2 hyperintense lesions on MRI...
62-year-old man with glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, MGMT promoter unmethylated...

eventExtraction.categoryIntro: Extract all clinically relevant and actionable events in the following categories:

categories.name: Genetic variants
categories.block:
**Category 1 — Genetic variants (ALWAYS include the variant type):**
Do NOT output a bare gene name. ALWAYS append the variant type.
Examples: "SCN1A mutation", "MECP2 mutation", "IDH1 mutation", "MGMT promoter methylation"

categories.name: Seizure / EEG findings
categories.block:
**Category 2 — Seizure / EEG findings:**
"generalized tonic-clonic seizures", "focal seizures", "epileptiform discharges"

categories.name: Imaging findings
categories.block:
**Category 3 — Imaging findings:**
"T2 hyperintense lesions", "contrast-enhancing mass", "hippocampal sclerosis"

categories.name: Biomarkers / CSF findings
categories.block:
**Category 4 — Biomarkers / CSF findings:**
"oligoclonal bands", "elevated CSF protein"

postCategoryNotes: Focus on information that is directly relevant to potential therapy selection or clinical management. Avoid vague or redundant information like "alert and oriented".

CRITICAL: For genetic events, NEVER emit just a gene name (e.g., "SCN1A"). ALWAYS include the variant type (e.g., "SCN1A mutation"). A bare gene name is not an actionable event — the variant type determines whether it is targetable.

fewShotExample.caseNoteInput: 8-year-old girl with drug-resistant epilepsy since infancy, presenting with generalized tonic-clonic seizures and frequent myoclonic jerks. EEG shows generalized epileptiform discharges. Genetic panel reveals a pathogenic SCN1A mutation, confirming a diagnosis of Dravet syndrome.

guidanceNotes: **Focus on Actionable Events:** We are not trying to summarize the case but to find what information is relevant to decision-making. This helps filter noise and focus on clinically significant findings.
**Prioritization:** Prioritizing genotype-driven studies ensures searches are matched to the patient's specific neurological or neurogenetic condition.
**Specific Search Terms:** Using exact terms such as "SCN1A mutation" is essential for precision. Adding "therapy", "treatment" or "clinical trials" helps to find relevant studies.
**Combinations:** Combining genetic and clinical/imaging features allows for refined searches that might be more relevant to the patient.
**Iteration:** If initial search results are not helpful, we can modify and refine the queries based on the available data.

articleScoring.evaluationGoal: evaluate full research articles related to neurological disease, especially those concerning genetic or structural neurological conditions, to identify potential advancements in treatment and understanding of the disease

domainFilterField.label: Neurological Focus
domainFilterField.description: Whether the article relates to a neurological condition

fields.label: Disease Match
fields.description: Set to true if the article's disease focus matches the patient's disease. Articles that cover the exact condition in question receive significant points.

fields.label: Drugs Tested
fields.description: Whether any drugs are mentioned as tested

fields.label: Treatment Results
fields.description: Set to true if the article demonstrates positive treatment results

fields.label: Cell Studies
fields.description: Whether drugs were tested on cells in vitro

fields.label: Animal Model Studies
fields.description: Whether drugs were tested in animal models

fields.label: Case Report
fields.description: Whether the article presents a case report

fields.label: Series of Case Reports
fields.description: Whether the article presents multiple case reports

fields.label: Clinical Study
fields.description: Whether the article describes a clinical study

fields.label: Pediatric Focus
fields.description: Whether the article focuses specifically on pediatric neurological disease

fields.label: Novelty
fields.description: If the paper describes a novel mechanism or therapeutic strategy
